split.method: First 60 days baseline, latest 30 days evaluation
split.leakage_controls: Scenario labels are evaluation targets only and are not included in feature vectors.

detection_delay_days.method: Days from synthetic scenario onset to first 3-day rolling statistical or shared-entity graph trigger.

limitations: Synthetic scenario labels are not representative of real payment fraud prevalence.
Isolation Forest is unsupervised and not a calibrated probability.
Detection delay is measured on generated scenario onset, not real payment-provider incident timestamps.
Results are an engineering benchmark, not production performance.
